ja265:1.1: Disvā khurappe dhanuveganunne khagge gahīte tikkhiṇe teladhote tasmiṃ bhayasmiṃ maraṇe viyūḷhe kasmā nu te nāhu chambhitattan ti.
ja265:2.1: Disvā khurappe dhanuveganunne khagge gahīte tikkhiṇe teladhote tasmiṃ bhayasmiṃ maraṇe viyūḷhe vedaṃ alatthaṃ vipulaṃ uḷāraṃ.
ja265:3.1: So vedajāto ajjhabhaviṃ amitte, pubbe va me jīvitam āsi cattaṃ, na hi jīvite ālayaṃ kubbamāno sūro kayirā sūrakiccaṃ kadāciti.
